highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 will improve rendering reliability through native engine fixes.
highlights_body: The upcoming update addresses image-filter caching, mask-filtered glyph rendering, and specific Vulkan allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

bullets.detail: Aligns image-filter cache-key equality with hashing, including signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata, so key lookup and eviction use consistent key identity.

Uses the reloaded glyph's outline when successive font-scaler loads disagree. Clears incompatible masks instead of overflowing sub-byte rows and preserves full plane strides when copying clipped emboss masks.

Avoids a driver failure when descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination GPUs. Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon the affected pool rather than destroy it; Graphite also blocks further allocation through that handle.
